summary: Silexion Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-10 reverse share split approved by shareholders on May 5, 2026, effective after market close on May 28, 2026, with split-adjusted trading starting May 29, 2026 on Nasdaq under the same ticker SLXN. No fractional shares will be issued; DTC participants' fractions will round up. The par value increases from $0.0135 to $0.135 per share. This routine capital-actions filing aims to regain Nasdaq compliance and is not a special situation.
